findings.title: Monitor context ignores the schedule_type translation it computes
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context, `config` is a copy of monitor.config with `schedule_type` replaced by the display string (lines 160-162), but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original, untranslated object) on line 168. The computed `config` is dead code, so the event's `contexts.monitor.config.schedule_type` carries the raw stored value instead of the intended display text. The bug was carried over unchanged from mark_failed.py, but this PR is the point where the function gets a new home, so it should be fixed here or tracked explicitly.

findings.title: get_failure_reason docstring examples do not match what the function returns
findings.body: The docstring says the output is "2 missed check-ins, 1 timeout check-in and 1 error check-in were detected" and "A failed check-in was detected". The code actually produces "2 missed, 1 timeout and 1 error check-ins detected" (the per-status text from HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP is joined and followed by " check-ins detected"). The singular case returns one of "An error check-in was detected", "A missed check-in was detected", or "A timeout check-in was detected"; there is no generic "A failed check-in" string. The docstring also has the typo "humam readible". Anyone maintaining the message text will be misled by these examples.

findings.title: Module-level names removed from mark_failed without updating any importers or mocks
findings.body: This change removes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `SimpleCheckIn`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and the status maps from mark_failed.py, and renames two of them (`create_issue_platform_occurrence` -> `create_incident_occurrence`, `mark_failed_threshold` -> `try_incident_threshold`). The diff touches only four files, so any remaining `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import ...` or `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")` (for example in tests) will fail with ImportError or AttributeError. The author should confirm with a repo-wide grep that no references remain, and call out the rename in the PR description.
